svg.text: The browser: eleven screens, one fetch client, no arithmetic
React 18 + Vite single page app. Every figure on every screen was computed by the API; the interface's job is to say what a number means and refuse to invent one.
Refetches the four rail counts on every route
change AND on every non-GET success

storage-guarded, read on every single request
Density, rail width, language — per browser
Thai first, English beside it — four files
eleven, in the order of the officer's day

KPI tiles, BarChart, what to do next
Seven tiers, grouped by customer; board view
The whole book: filters, columns, governed export
One case: contacts, PTP, next action, timeline
What a manager has to decide, and why it arrived

• Every failure renders Problem.jsx from the API's own
envelope — never a generic 'something went wrong'.
get / post / send over BASE = '/api'; roleHeaders() on every call
Throws with .problem attached, so a screen can render the real reason
Dispatched on window after every non-GET success —

no CORS, no second IAP session
